fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable royal name (Prince, Queen, King). Matches BossTypes.NAME in the Godot port.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: Stable machine id (prince/queen/king) — the exact lowercase key the projectile layer's per-boss scalars expect.

fields.name: rank
fields.title: Rank
fields.description: Boss progression rank. 1 = Prince (floor 4), 2 = Queen (floor 7), 3 = King (floor 10, unlocks the next floor).

fields.name: statBlock
fields.title: Stat block
fields.description: Base (pre-prestige, pre-floor) combat stats from BossTypes.HP / BossTypes.DMG. Effective stats compose prestige^killCount * 1.3^(floor-1).

fields.name: damage
fields.title: Base damage
fields.description: Base contact/attack damage dealt to the player. BossTypes.DMG[type].

fields.name: prestigeValue
fields.title: Prestige value
fields.description: Score / threat weight emitted on kill for the progression cluster. BossTypes.PRESTIGE[type].

fields.name: spawnsOnWaves
fields.title: Spawns on waves
fields.description: Wave-in-floor positions where a boss occupies the slot (4, 7, 10 in the Godot wave_manager). The boss-wave rows in the enemy personality matrix are inert filler — the boss takes over at these positions.

fields.name: unlocksFloor
fields.title: Unlocks floor
fields.description: True only for the King — killing it unlocks the next floor (BossTypes.unlocks_floor returns true for KING).

fields.name: telegraph
fields.title: Telegraph
fields.description: Wind-up tell shape the boss shares across abilities. The fair-tell band sits at 0.5-1.0s in the port; longer durations read as heavier commits.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration (s)
fields.description: Seconds the boss winds up before a telegraphed ability fires. boss.gd TELEGRAPH_DURATION baseline.

fields.name: glow
fields.title: Glow
fields.description: Whether the body emits the ramping per-ability tint during the wind-up (orange missiles / red lasers / gold royal-decree).

fields.name: scaleSwell
fields.title: Scale swell
fields.description: Whether the body swells in scale across the telegraph as part of the wind-up read.

fields.name: abilities
fields.title: Abilities
fields.description: The abilities this royal's arbiter can fire. References into the bossAbility collection. Order is the arbiter priority hint (missiles > lasers in the source).
